verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents webhooks for both products. Transactional POSTs message events (send, bounce, delivered, open, click, spam, unsub, reject), with a test/debug guide. Marketing webhooks send POST updates on subscriptions, changed emails and campaign sending, with signature verification documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and broader availability, since webhooks require the Standard or Premium plan (Free/Essentials users are prompted to upgrade).
